items.name: Subaward Agreement Extraction
items.description: Uploads a federal subaward agreement and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Subaward Summary covering basic award information, project periods, PTE / Subrecipient contact tables (Role | Name | Email | Phone), financial summary with monetary-accuracy verification, financial policies, reporting requirements (Technical / Financial / Invention sub-bullets), prior approval requirements, and key compliance requirements. Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping subaward-extraction consolidation.md conventions, including the "VERIFY CAREFULLY" annotation on Total Subaward Amount.

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200)
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Primary regulatory KB — §§ 200.331-332 cover subaward rules. For contract subawards, swap in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). When the operator does not attach a KB, the extraction falls back to reading just the uploaded subaward agreement.

data.name: extract-core-award
data.prompt:
You are extracting the basic award information from a federal
subaward agreement. You receive the uploaded document AND any
KB chunks.

Emit a JSON object with: pte_name, subrecipient_name,
pte_federal_award_number, subaward_number, project_title,
federal_awarding_agency, prime_award_period_start (ISO
YYYY-MM-DD or null), prime_award_period_end (ISO YYYY-MM-DD
or null), subaward_period_start (ISO YYYY-MM-DD),
subaward_period_end (ISO YYYY-MM-DD).

Be 100% accurate. Quote identifiers verbatim. Use null when
absent.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-contacts
data.prompt:
You are extracting contact information from a federal subaward
agreement.

For each contact, emit name (STRING), email (STRING), phone
(STRING formatted as XXX-XXX-XXXX). Use null for any missing
field.

Emit a JSON object with:
- pte_contacts: JSON ARRAY of {role, name, email, phone}
  objects — four rows (Principal Investigator, Administrative
  Contact, Financial Contact, Authorized Official).
- subrecipient_contacts: JSON ARRAY of same shape — same
  four rows.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-financial
data.prompt:
You are extracting financial details from a federal subaward
agreement.

CRITICAL — monetary accuracy is vital. Cross-check amounts
in multiple document locations. Common errors: missing
commas, transposed digits, wrong decimals.

Emit a JSON object with: total_subaward_amount (STRING),
total_direct_costs (STRING), total_indirect_costs (STRING),
cost_type (one of "Fixed Price", "Cost Reimbursement",
"Milestone", "Other"), indirect_cost_rate (STRING e.g.,
"47.5%"), indirect_cost_base (STRING e.g., "MTDC"),
cost_sharing_required (BOOLEAN), cost_sharing_details
(STRING or null), carryforward_policy (STRING or null).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-financial-policies
data.prompt:
You are extracting financial policies and invoicing rules
from a federal subaward agreement.

Emit a JSON object with: invoicing_frequency (one of
"Monthly", "Quarterly", "Upon Milestone", "Annually",
"Other"), final_invoice_deadline (STRING),
required_invoice_elements (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS),
payment_terms (STRING or null), banking_information_required
(BOOLEAN).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-reporting
data.prompt:
You are extracting reporting requirements from a federal
subaward agreement.

Emit a JSON object with:
- technical_reports: JSON ARRAY of {frequency, deadline,
  recipient} objects (Monthly / Quarterly / Annual / Final
  as applicable).
- financial_reports: JSON ARRAY of same shape (Final
  statement, interim statements).
- invention_reporting: JSON ARRAY of {type, deadline}
  objects (Disclosure, Final invention report).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-compliance
data.prompt:
You are extracting compliance requirements and prior-approval
rules from a federal subaward agreement.

Emit a JSON object with: prior_approval_general_rule (STRING
— who to contact for approvals), prior_approval_specific (JSON
ARRAY of {category, requirement} objects — no-cost extensions,
PI / key personnel changes, equipment, etc.),
governing_regulations (JSON ARRAY of STRINGS),
fcoi_policy (STRING — whose FCOI policy applies),
data_rights (STRING), certifications_required (JSON ARRAY of
STRINGS), termination_notice_period (STRING),
record_retention (STRING).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: subaward-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Subaward Agreement
Extraction workflow. You receive SIX JSON fragments from the
previous step.

CRITICAL — cross-check monetary amounts across fragments.
Flag any reconciliation gap (Total Direct + Total Indirect ≠
Total Subaward Amount) in the Financial Summary section with
"[VERIFY CAREFULLY - Direct + Indirect = $X, Total Subaward
Amount = $Y, reconciliation gap $Z]".

Render a single RA-friendly Markdown Subaward Summary.
Mirrors source consolidation.md exactly.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Empty arrays: render the section with its empty-state
  language already specified below (e.g., "No items identified",
  "Defers to federal defaults", "None identified beyond
  standard federal requirements").

If EVERY field across ALL upstream fragments is null (which
means the document genuinely contained nothing extractable
OR the document was not attached to the run), STILL render
the full Markdown structure with "Not specified in the
document" placeholders throughout, AND append a single line
at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Subaward Summary: <subaward_number>

### Basic Award Information

- **Pass-Through Entity (PTE) Name:** <pte_name>
- **Subrecipient Name:** <subrecipient_name>
- **PTE Federal Award Number:** <pte_federal_award_number>
- **Subaward Number:** <subaward_number>
- **Project Title:** <project_title>
- **Federal Awarding Agency:** <federal_awarding_agency>

---

### Project Periods

- **Subaward Period:** <subaward_period_start> — <subaward_period_end>
- **Prime Award Period:** <prime_award_period_start or "Not specified"> — <prime_award_period_end or "Not specified">

---

### Pass-Through Entity (PTE) Contacts

| Role | Name | Email | Phone |
|------|------|-------|-------|

One row per pte_contacts entry. Use "—" for any null field.

---

### Subrecipient Contacts

| Role | Name | Email | Phone |
|------|------|-------|-------|

One row per subrecipient_contacts entry. Use "—" for any null
field.

---

### Financial Summary

- **Total Subaward Amount:** <total_subaward_amount> *[VERIFY CAREFULLY]*
- **Total Direct Costs:** <total_direct_costs>
- **Total Indirect Costs (F&A):** <total_indirect_costs>
- **Cost Type:** <cost_type>

*[If reconciliation gap detected: "[VERIFY CAREFULLY - Direct + Indirect = $X, Total Subaward Amount = $Y, reconciliation gap $Z]"]*

---

### Financial Policies

- **Invoicing Frequency:** <invoicing_frequency>
- **Final Invoice Due:** <final_invoice_deadline>
- **Required Invoice Elements:** <bulleted list from required_invoice_elements>
- **Indirect Cost Rate:** <indirect_cost_rate> on <indirect_cost_base>
- **Cost Sharing Required:** <Yes / No>
- **Carryforward Policy:** <carryforward_policy or "Standard federal default">

---

### Reporting Requirements

- **Technical Reports:**
  - <one sub-bullet per technical_reports entry: "<frequency>: <deadline> to <recipient>">
- **Financial Reports:**
  - <one sub-bullet per financial_reports entry>
- **Invention Reporting:**
  - <one sub-bullet per invention_reporting entry: "<type>: <deadline>">

---

### Prior Approval Requirements

- **General Rule:** <prior_approval_general_rule or "Contact PTE Grants Officer for all prior approvals">
- **Specific Requirements:**
  - <one sub-bullet per prior_approval_specific entry: "<category>: <requirement>">

---

### Key Compliance Requirements

- **Governing Regulations:** <bulleted list from governing_regulations>
- **Financial COI Policy:** <fcoi_policy or "Subrecipient's FCOI policy applies per 2 CFR 200.112">
- **Data Rights:** <data_rights or "Standard federal default">
- **Certifications Required:** <bulleted list from certifications_required>
- **Termination:** <termination_notice_period or "30-day written notice">
- **Record Retention:** <record_retention or "3 years per 2 CFR 200.334">

## Rendering rules

- Mixed-case section titles (matches source consolidation.md
  convention — NOT UPPERCASE like other workflows).
- Format phone numbers consistently as XXX-XXX-XXXX (add
  dashes where missing).
- Preserve monetary amounts verbatim with $ and commas.
- Use "—" for empty optional fields.
- Flag reconciliation gaps with [VERIFY CAREFULLY - ...].
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE
  into prose / table.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify Total Subaward Amount, Total Direct Costs, Total Indirect Costs preserve the source document's exact figures (no missing/extra commas, no transposed digits, no wrong decimals).
Verify phone numbers are formatted consistently with dashes; emails are preserved verbatim.
Verify Total Direct Costs + Total Indirect Costs equals Total Subaward Amount; flag any deviation.
